newsitem.title: UK: Fenner sells gear unit for 5 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Fenner sells gear unit for 5 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Fenner Plc said on Monday it had sold the business and assets of its gear manufacturing facility for five million stg to Japan's Sumitomo Heavy Industries.
Fenner's chief executive Mark Abrahams said in a statement that the disposal was part of its plans to concentrate on its main power transmission business.
Fenner would, however, continue to distribute gear products under a supply agreement with Sumitomo.
"The transaction will have no mterial effect on Fenner Group profitability," the company said.
Fenner said the cash consideration for the transaction is equivalent to the net assets disposed of and would initially be applied to fund the group's investments in its core business.
